testcase.name: Scenario: Dismiss the appearance submenu without changing the ribbon: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-appearance-source/features/application/ribbon-appearance/ribbon-appearance.feature:70:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dismiss the appearance submenu without changing the ribbon ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Tools ribbon uses the Normal appearance ✔ And Team Web, Tutorials, and User Commands are enabled in Show Panels ✔ When the user right-clicks the Options panel title and opens "Ribbon Appearance" ✔ And the user presses Escape ✔ Then the appearance submenu closes and the panel context menu remains open ✔ When the user presses Escape again ✔ Then the panel context menu closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains in the Normal appearance
